paper_title: Searching for vector dark matter with an optomechanical accelerometer
notes: Projected (not measured) sensitivity of a proposed Si3N4 membrane / Be mirror optomechanical accelerometer to vector B-L dark matter (Fig. 2). Values read approximately from the resonant minima of the 1-year blue projection curves for 2.5-20 cm membranes (resonances ~2-25 kHz, i.e. mDM ~8e-12 to 1e-10 eV). Coupling is dimensionless gB-L. The paper also projects B-coupled dark photon sensitivity (Fig. 4). Reference bounds shown (Eot-Wash, LIGO, MICROSCOPE) are not this paper's result.
